calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.sale_date, s.store_id, s.format, f.net_amount, f.receipt_id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.format, COALESCE(w.status,'(store)') AS web_status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(l.net_amount) AS sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) AS returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),2) AS rate
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = l.receipt_id AND l.store_id = 900
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format ORDER BY l.format
